components.constructor: GenerationManager.__init__ creates JobStore, spawn context, queues/events, locks, status and lifecycle flags.
components.start: start_async starts collector then _start_worker; _start_worker increments generation and starts tpu-0.
components.stop: shutdown sets _shutting_down, stops worker and collector; _stop_worker sends sentinel, joins/terminates/kills.
components.restart: restart_worker disables acceptance, optionally waits/fails pending, stops worker, replaces queues/event, then _start_worker.
components.load_location: _start_worker launches model_worker_main; manager does not load the model.

components.constructor: Function entry receives worker_id, generation, payload, queues, shutdown event; creates MemoryGuardMonitor.
components.start: Sets JAX environment/cache, emits loading, imports TPU libraries, creates engine and calls engine.load.
components.stop: Observes shutdown_event or task sentinel, stops monitor, emits worker_stopped.
components.restart: No direct restart ownership; a replacement invocation is started by GenerationManager.
components.identity: worker_id and generation are included in every emitted event; pid is emitted.
components.locks_events: Multiprocessing shutdown_event; result-queue events worker_state, worker_ready, load_error, job events, worker_stopped.
components.state_fields: Local engine, metadata, monitor, task loop.
components.load_location: Gemma4TPUEngine construction and engine.load inside this spawned worker.
components.cleanup_location: monitor.stop on load error and graceful loop exit.

components.constructor: JobStore.__init__ creates OrderedDict, RLock, capacity and TTL settings.
components.stop: No process stop; terminal cleanup occurs by TTL/capacity removal.
components.restart: fail_pending targets queued and processing jobs; completed/failed are excluded.
components.state_fields: Job status queued, processing, completed, failed; timestamps, result/error/runtime fields.
components.cleanup_location: _cleanup and capacity eviction; terminal methods clear image.

components.start: Async generation handlers call submit; restart creates http-restart thread.
components.stop: No app-owned worker stop route; lifecycle is delegated to manager.
components.restart: POST /restart checks API auth and X-Restart-Secret, acquires Runtime.restart_lock, starts manager.restart_worker in one thread.
components.identity: HTTP request ID and job ID are propagated.
components.cleanup_location: Restart thread releases restart_lock in finally.

components.start: submit puts serialized job work; _stop_worker puts None sentinel.
components.stop: Closed and replaced by restart_worker after old worker stop.
components.identity: One manager-owned queue for the active generation.
components.load_location: Feeds worker load-complete task loop only.

components.start: worker emits lifecycle/job messages; collector receives them.
components.cleanup_location: result_queue.close in restart_worker; collector join in shutdown.

components.restart: Old process is stopped before replacement start is intended.
components.locks_events: Managed under manager _lock in current source; shutdown_event passed to child.

components.constructor: Created lazily in start_async as tpu-results daemon.
components.start: Runs _collect and dispatches result queue messages to _handle.
components.restart: Persists across manager restart; consumes current result_queue by attribute lookup.

components.constructor: _start_worker creates tpu-monitor and tpu-load-watchdog daemon threads.
components.start: Monitor joins child; watchdog observes starting/loading deadline.
components.stop: Monitor returns on shutdown; watchdog returns on state/generation change or shutdown.
components.restart: Monitor may automatically _start_worker after unexpected stop; watchdog is generation-scoped.
components.cleanup_location: Monitor clears pid after child exit.

components.constructor: Flask restart handler builds run_restart closure.
components.restart: Exactly one HTTP-admitted thread owns Runtime.restart_lock; concurrent HTTP request gets 409.

components.constructor: model_worker_main constructs it with model path, dtype, distribution and generation configuration.
components.start: load imports KerasHub, strictly loads preset, compiles sampler with run_eagerly=True, validates, and returns metadata.
components.stop: No explicit engine stop method is observed.
components.restart: A new engine is constructed for each new worker lifecycle.
components.identity: One local engine variable in one model_worker_main invocation.
components.locks_events: No lifecycle lock observed in engine; phase callback reports monitor phases.
components.cleanup_location: _post_load_host_cleanup during load; process exit releases remaining engine state.
